resources.string: The private key is missing or unreadable. Re-import a backup containing the private key, or check the original device. Other data and the remote backup were kept.
This passkey uses a device-bound Android Keystore key that cannot be exported. It can still work on the original device, but cannot be included in a portable backup.
The protected private key could not be read. Unlock Monica and retry; if this continues, check the original device or a backup containing the private key.
